units.source_text: 整个夏季我都没有造访母亲的寄居地。

en.t: All summer long, I did not visit the place where my mother was staying.

units.source_text: 由于伙食粗劣，夏天我的身体也够受的。

en.t: Because the food was poor, the summer took quite a toll on my body as well.

units.source_text: 9月10日以后的一天，气象预报说可能有强飓风袭来。

en.t: One day after September 10, the weather forecast said that a powerful typhoon might strike.

units.source_text: 需要有人去金阁值夜班。

en.t: Someone needed to go to the Golden Pavilion and keep night watch.
I volunteered to take the shift.
